attributes.description: Saper utilizzare uno strumento di AI generativa per raccogliere idee e produrre una prima bozza di testo su un tema dato, formulando una richiesta iniziale generica

Verificare l'attendibilita delle informazioni generate dall'AI attraverso fonti affidabili quali articoli scientifici, rapporti istituzionali e documenti di organizzazioni riconosciute
Migliorare la formulazione del prompt specificando contesto, pubblico, periodo temporale e tipo di evidenze richieste, e confrontare criticamente le risposte ottenute

attributes.title: Watching the prompts: writing a first business prompt
attributes.challenge: “The business owners in my workshop want to use AI for routine customer messages, but most have hardly used it and don’t know where to start.”

attributes.knowledge: little or no AI experience. Facilitator: small-business digital adviser, with a peer owner who already uses AI.
attributes.role: Owners and office managers of six micro-businesses

attributes.description: Drafting routine customer messages (payment reminders, social media posts).
Identify relevant prompting choices and construct a first prompt for a task from one’s own business.
attributes.contextDetails: Little or no AI use, so the first need is knowing how to ask. A first prompt, not a working routine, is a realistic target for one evening.

attributes.inPractice: The adviser builds a payment-reminder prompt live, thinking aloud and showing weak and improved versions side by side, including one change that made it worse. A peer owner shows her own prompts, failures included. Learners tick ‘prompt moves’ on a card, annotate a transcript in pairs, then write a prompt for their own business and explain two choices.
attributes.rationale: Watching before doing lowers the threshold for novices. Modelling builds prompting competence only if the decisions are made visible and learners then use them in a prompt of their own; a polished demo of finished outputs would build familiarity, not competence.
